from.place: Milnor: eventual constancy and cone projections

title: Eventually constant Roos projection
statement: Let C be an abelian category with a derived category D(C) having countable products. Suppose H^j preserves countable products for every integer j. For a tower F : ℕᵒᵖ → D(C), a homotopy-limit cone c and integers q and natural N, assume the successor transitions are isomorphisms on H^q and H^(q-1) for all indices at least N. Then H^q(c → F_n) is an isomorphism for every n≥N.

proof.text: Use homotopy-limit tail invariance to discard indices below n. In degree q-1 construct a section of 1-T recursively: x_0=0 and x_(i+1)=(x_i-proj_i) followed by the inverse transition. The product universal property and telescoping verify that it is a section, hence 1-T is epic. The Milnor long exact sequence makes the first degree-q arrow monic and exact as the kernel of its difference map. Compose inverse transition isomorphisms to give a compatible family of maps from the zeroth term to all terms; lift its product map through this kernel. The zeroth projection gives one inverse identity. Product extensionality, cone compatibility and induction give the other.

theorem DerivedCategory.isIso_homology_map_cone_leg_of_eventually_isIso
    {C : Type*} [Category C] [Abelian C] [HasDerivedCategory C]
    [HasCountableProducts (DerivedCategory C)]
    (F : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ DerivedCategory C) (c : Cone F)
    (hc : IsHomotopyLimit c)
    (hprod : ∀ j : ℤ, PreservesLimitsOfShape (Discrete ℕ)
      (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor C j))
    (q : ℤ) (N : ℕ)
    (ht : ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n →
      IsIso ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor C q).map
        (F.map (homOfLE n.le_succ).op)) ∧
      IsIso ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor C (q - 1)).map
        (F.map (homOfLE n.le_succ).op)))
    (n : ℕ) (hn : N ≤ n) :
    IsIso ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor C q).map (c.π.app (op n)))
